summary: The recorded base reproduced stale BFS and PROB cached drafts. The exact candidate rebuilt its changed native C++ library and made cached results agree with fresh and erased-state results in the original reproducer, the focused suite, and independent differential stress coverage.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base reproduction: BFS and PROB cached requests returned [30,70,80,90], while fresh and erased-state controls returned [30,40,50,60].
Exact-candidate original contract: cached, fresh, and erased-state results all returned [30,40,50,60] for BFS and PROB.
Candidate regression and focused NGRAM suite: 43 tests passed, including 12 new parameterized subtests.
Independent adversarial differential: 80 repeated-growth cached/fresh comparisons passed in each of BFS and PROB, including bounded-capacity eviction. The recorded base failed at BFS step 0.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was visible, but the original issue and rebuilt NGRAM extension are CPU C++ data-structure paths; no GPU kernel was executed.

remaining_limitations: No model, HTTP serving, semantic-accuracy, or distributed workload was exercised because none is part of the original model-free CPU contract.
No GPU-kernel behavior is claimed; the host architecture was x86_64 and the visible accelerator was one gfx950 MI350X.
